frames.title: Lesson 149 · Reported questions and commands — practice and contrast

body: **Foco:** Reported questions and commands — prática e contraste.
**Pronúncia:** Redução de palavras funcionais (to, of, for, and, can).
**20 palavras novas** (política como tema de discussão).

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (B2):** eu consigo contrastar fala direta e indireta (perguntas e ordens) numa resenha de um documentário.

body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Review: The Campaign Trail (documentary)
paras: In the film a candidate **asks** voters, “What worries you?” Later we hear the reporter **ask** her **if she was** tired. An aide **tells** her **to rest**; she **refuses**. Her manager **warned** her **not to** skip lunch, and a voter **wanted to know** whether she **would keep** her promises.
The camera work is superb, though the story drags. Four stars.

items.q: The candidate asks voters what worries them.
Her aide tells her to keep campaigning without rest.

head: Direta
Indireta
rows: He asked her **if she was** tired.
He warned her **not to skip** lunch.

blocks.body: No indireto, **pronomes e tempo mudam**: *am → was*, *will → would*, *this → that*. Perguntas **não usam do/does** e **não têm ponto de interrogação**.

items.s: He asked her ___ she was tired. (if)
He warned her ___ to skip lunch. (not)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.pt: Ela perguntou o que os preocupava.

items.ans: And what did the aide tell her
items.pt: E o que o assessor disse a ela?

body: **Run out of steam.** — Perder o fôlego.
**Burn the candle at both ends.** — Trabalhar sem parar.
**Go the distance.** — Ir até o fim.
**What did the candidate ask the voters?** — O que a candidata perguntou aos eleitores?
**She asked what worried them.** — Ela perguntou o que os preocupava.
**And what did the aide tell her?** — E o que o assessor disse a ela?

blocks.title: Pronúncia: Redução de palavras funcionais (to, of, for, and, can)

items.label: Redução de palavras funcionais (to, of, for, and, can)
items.note: Palavras funcionais ficam fracas: to /tə/, of /əv/, for /fər/, and /ən/, can /kən/.

prompts.model: “Are you ready?” → He asked if I was ready.
She warned me not to go.

blocks.task: Write 5 sentences turning direct questions and commands into reported speech.
blocks.model: She asked what worried voters. He asked her if she was tired. The aide told her to rest. Her manager warned her not to skip lunch. A voter wanted to know whether she would keep her promises.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
